verdict.rationale: Ironclad uses OAuth 2.0. You can register a dedicated client application and use the Client Credentials Grant to mint bearer tokens, which gives an agent its own distinct, revocable credential. However, the evidence never mentions scopes or permission limits, and API access requires the API add-on, so least-privilege scoping is not shown. Missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or per-resource permission restriction for client apps, guidance on least-privilege or agent-specific credentials, token lifetime and rotation details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
